verdict: Maybe. Gud Gum pitched a healthy, plastic-free chewing gum on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from four sharks. Most chewing gum uses a synthetic base, so a natural gum with no sugar has a clear story, but big brands own the checkout counters.
angle: Natural gum bases made from tree sap, with natural sweeteners, appeal to health- and eco-conscious buyers. Impulse purchases happen at checkouts, which big brands control, so quick commerce and online sales are the realistic starting channels.
